desc:
🎲 Welcome to Throw Dice For Anime!

How to Play:
🎯 Throw your dice as far as you can
✨ Discover and collect anime units from different zones
💸 Place units in your base to earn money—even while offline!
🎲 Buy better dice for a higher chance of rare units
💪 Train on pull-up bars to increase your Throw Power
🌎 Reach new zones and discover stronger characters
🌟 Find giant units with Golden and Diamond mutations
🏡 Upgrade your base to make room for more units!
